name: Clipway
description:
Clipboard capture for the Clipway clipboard manager.

This extension reads what you copy and passes it to the Clipway app on this computer, which keeps an encrypted history. Nothing leaves your computer.

Requires the Clipway app (clipway-daemon). Without it, nothing is recorded.

Content that password managers mark as secret, copies from excluded apps and anything copied in incognito mode are never recorded. No keyboard shortcut is set by default; choose one in Clipway's settings.
